first.rationale: Referral incentives currently have the strongest direct evidence for sustainable qualified revenue without retention harm. Verify that evidence and compare it with promotional pricing, whose acquisition lift may carry customer-quality, margin, or retention risk despite the competitive pricing threat.

final.rationale: Run a referral-incentive experiment limited to established customers older than six months. The verified source showed +7% qualified revenue and +2% 30-day retention, directly supporting sustainable growth. Reject promotional pricing despite the competitive threat because its +18% qualified-revenue lift came with 12% lower retention and failure through the first renewal cycle. This experiment will not directly repair activation or onboarding declines, but it offers the strongest verified fit to the primary objective within the available slot.
